## About
The Ganley Collision Center sits at Ken Ganley Lincoln on Pearl Road in Middleburg Heights. Our team has extensive knowledge of automotive repair and bodywork, and we use modern practices to get each job done the right way.
We know collision repair can be a tricky process, especially after an accident. We aim to take that stress off your shoulders. Whether it's a serious accident or just a scratch, you can bring your car or truck here.
Customers have given us a 4 star rating across 93 Google reviews, and they often mention people by name: Rose in customer service, Jerry our estimator, Sandy, and Jack and his crew.

## Services
- Fender bender dents: Got dents from a fender bender on your daily commute? You can get those dents taken care of here.
- Scratch and paint repair: We buff out scratches and match your paint so your car looks the way it should.
- Accident body damage: Body work after more serious accidents, for your car or truck.
- Collision care for your Lincoln: Whatever the model, our collision center is ready to take care of your Lincoln.
- Repairs on almost any vehicle: We can handle the repairs of almost any vehicle that comes into our facility.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on Lincoln vehicles?
A: No. We're a Lincoln dealership, but our collision center works on other makes too.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free.

Q: Do you have more than one location?
A: Yes. Our collision center is here in Middleburg Heights, and we have a second one in Cleveland.
